system.description: Beginning at 9th level, you learn how to reinforce your allies to fight on past their injuries. As a Bonus action, you can spend a superiority die to select up to 4 allied creatures within 30 feet of you, excluding yourself. They gain temporary hit points equal to your level. Temporary hit points gained this way disperse after 1 minute.
